author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 우리나라에서는 매우 드물게 보이는 겨울새로, 평야와 간척지의 논, 하구 등에서 지낸다. 주로 낟알이나 씨, 잎 같은 식물을 먹고 물속 연체동물, 곤충, 조개류 등도 먹는다. 번식지에서는 하루에 한 개씩 알 4~8개를 낳고, 새끼는 40~50일에 걸쳐 자란다. 시베리아 북동부에서 번식하는 무리는 중국 북부와 일본 등지에서, 북아메리카 툰드라에서 번식하는 무리는 멕시코만과 캘리포니아에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Snow Goose (Anser caerulescens), adult white morph in winter: entire head, neck, body, tail and wing coverts pure white, the face sometimes stained rusty-orange from feeding in mud; primaries black, showing as a black wingtip below the white tertials at rest; primary coverts grey; bill pink with a whitish nail and a black 'grinning patch' along the cutting edges of both mandibles; dark eye; legs and feet deep pink.
art.pose: grazing in a rice paddy, side view
art.scene: flat Korean reclaimed farmland in winter: rice paddies near an estuary; no people, buildings or text
views: adult white morph, side view standing in a paddy: all-white plumage, black primary tips showing at the rear, pink bill with a black grinning patch, pink legs
adult white morph, in flight seen from below: white body and wings with only the primaries black, short neck stretched forward, pink bill and feet
juvenile white morph, side view standing: dusky grey-brown crown, hindneck, back and wing coverts, whitish-grey face and underparts with a grey wash, dark grey bill and legs
art.build: Medium-sized goose, 67cm, much bigger than a Mallard but clearly smaller than a Bean Goose, with a rather short, thick neck and a rounded head. Bill stout, shorter than the head, deep at the base, with the black cutting edges visible as a dark oval 'grin'. Legs medium length, pink. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. Tail short, white. In flight white with sharply black primaries forming black outer wingtips, and grey primary coverts.
avoid: Do not paint black secondaries or a black trailing edge along the whole wing; only the primaries are black.
Do not paint a long neck, long legs or a red bare face; that is Siberian Crane (Leucogeranus leucogeranus). This is a short-necked goose.
Do not paint a black or yellow bill as on swans; the bill is pink.
Do not paint grey or brown on the adult's back; that is juvenile plumage.
